title: 2019-20 Panini NBA Hoops PJ Washington Jr. RC #209 Charlotte Hornets
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: This 2019-20 Panini NBA Hoops trading card features PJ Washington Jr. of the Charlotte Hornets, card number 209. It is a rookie card and part of the 2019-20 Panini NBA Hoops set. The card is perfect for any basketball fan or collector looking to add a valuable piece to their collection. The card is in great shape and ready to be added to your collection.
